name: DaVinci Text+ Premium Caption Stack
use_when: A Resolve short needs premium animated captions or emphasis text beyond basic auto captions.
B-roll or hook moments need large text stacks, gradient text, glow, blur, or glitch emphasis.
The agent wants reusable Text+ caption presets.
avoid_when: Simple auto captions are enough for the project style.
The screen already contains too much text or important face/action detail.
The subject is serious and premium social text would feel inappropriate.

timeline_pattern.pattern: Text+ -> Fusion -> GaussianBlur_optional -> Transform -> keyframed_scale_position -> Spline_out_cubic -> shading_gradient_or_glow -> staggered_stack -> caption_qc
timeline_pattern.textplus_rule: Use Text+ for custom Resolve caption/text animation, not basic Text, when Fusion control is needed.
timeline_pattern.stack_rule: Build short staggered text layers for emphasis; keep each layer short enough to read.
timeline_pattern.auto_caption_rule: Use Resolve auto captions for simple style, then replace or supplement key B-roll moments with Text+ premium captions.
timeline_pattern.typography_rule: Use weight, hue, case, and size contrast to create hierarchy before adding gradient, glow, blur, or glitch.

motion.rule: Use Transform keyframes for caption entrance and Spline easing for crisp motion.

keyframe_values.text_start_size: Use a smaller start scale such as 0.3 for a dramatic pop, or 0.1 for a larger slide-up feel, then animate toward the final size.
keyframe_values.animation_length: Around 50 frames can work for slower premium text moves; shorten for dense hook stacks.
keyframe_values.staggered_stack_clip_length: Short text-stack layers can be trimmed to about 4 frames each for fast stacked emphasis.
keyframe_values.glitch_opacity: Alternate opacity up/down every 2-3 frames for a quick glitch/flicker effect.
keyframe_values.stop_motion: A Stop Motion value around 3 can add choppy glitch texture when the style calls for it.
keyframe_values.tracking: Only tighten tracking on large emphasis words after checking readability; keep subtitle-sized text near normal spacing.

sound.rule: Text pops and glitches can receive small SFX, but speech must stay dominant.

captions.rule: Premium Text+ captions should not duplicate auto captions unless the duplicate is the intended emphasis.
captions.style_rule: Use gradient, glow, blur, or opacity only where it improves emphasis and remains readable.

color.rule: Gradient text should preserve contrast; choose colors that match the short's visual style and do not disappear into the background. Avoid heavy default shadows when text already has enough contrast.

implementation.ffmpeg: Approximate with drawtext, alpha/opacity envelopes, glow-like layered text, and contact-sheet review for readability.
implementation.remotion: Represent Text+ stacks as animated text components with gradient, glow, blur, opacityFlickerFrames, easing, and layerDuration fields.
implementation.blender: Use text objects, emission/glow materials, opacity keyframes, and eased transforms for custom rendered caption stacks.
implementation.capcut_equivalent: Use text templates, glow, gradient-like styles, and short staggered text clips, then review for caption collisions.
implementation.premiere_equivalent: Use Essential Graphics, text gradients where available, blur/glow effects, opacity keyframes, and Motion presets.

common_mistakes: Using Text+ stacks everywhere instead of on the moments that need emphasis.
Duplicating auto captions and premium text until the screen becomes unreadable.
Using gradient or glow that lowers readability at phone size.
Forgetting to save a checked caption animation as a reusable preset.
Adding premium effects before the word hierarchy is clear.
qc: Is the premium Text+ moment attached to a key line or B-roll beat?
Is the text readable at phone size over the actual background?
Do auto captions and Text+ captions avoid duplicate clutter?
Do gradient, glow, blur, or glitch effects preserve legibility?
Can the Text+ effect be reused from a preset without rebuilding it?
Does the premium treatment emphasize the line's impact word or phrase?
